description:
We are 3rd-year Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) students with a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, IoT, embedded systems, and innovative technology solutions.
We enjoy learning new technologies and turning creative ideas into practical projects. We have worked on projects involving ESP32, sensor integration, real-time monitoring dashboards, AI-based water quality monitoring, and image-based mango ripeness prediction.
summary: Bengaluru ClimateScope is a climate analysis project that uses NASA POWER data to investigate temperature, rainfall and relative humidity trends in Bengaluru from 2001 to 2024. Developed using Python and Streamlit, it processes historical data, performs statistical trend analysis and displays findings through an interactive dashboard. The analysis estimated increasing temperature and rainfall trends and decreasing humidity, but none was statistically significant at the 5% level. The project promotes climate awareness through NASA data, scientific analysis and easy-to-understand visualizations.
details: Bengaluru ClimateScope is a Python-based climate investigation tool that uses NASA POWER data to study temperature, rainfall and relative humidity trends in Bengaluru from 2001 to 2024. It processes historical data, applies statistical trend analysis and presents the findings through an interactive Streamlit dashboard. The analysis found estimated increases in temperature and rainfall and a slight decrease in relative humidity, but none of these trends was statistically significant at the 5% level. The project's main value is making NASA climate data accessible and understandable while encouraging evidence-based environmental awareness.
